Phew~, the road paved for the Eumanos is so soft\nthat walking on it drains all my energy~.\nLemme take a short break~!
Sorry, but this way it's easier for us to walk on\nand it enables us to absorb some nutrients too...
If we don't get nutrients, we can't become a\n"Sproutling" even if we want to...
Huh? "Sproutling"? What's that?
There is a seed in the back of our head.\nThe seed will sprout and develop into a flower.\nThis phenomenon is called "sprouting".
Umm...Then what happens if the flower blooms?
A "Sproutling" has great magical power and is good\nat combat. If your flower blooms, that means you\nare independent and have become a great soldier.
You're also allowed to set out on a journey to\nfind the ideal land that will become your\nterritory if you want to.
Wow, that's cool!\nSo when is the flower gonna bloom?
Uh...they say it depends on the potential each\nindividual is born with...\nThe sprouting time may vary.
Some experienced it when they were young and some\nhave yet to experience it although they're already\nold... Honestly, we can't really tell the time...
I see...It must be frustrating when it doesn't\nturn out the way you want it to...
I see...It must be frustrating when it doesn't\nturn out the way you want it to...\nWell, that's enough rest! Shall we continue?
Hey! What's wrong? You don't seem very well...
Oh?! Whoa, whoa, whoaaa!
S-sorry! Are you all right?
You don't look very well though,\nwhat's the matter?
Uh?! Oh, the thing is...I'm only here because a\nfriend asked me to join him to get rid of Coenubia\nwith an adventurer from another world.
But...I'm the tiniest one here and I'm actually a\ncoward and not good at fighting...\nI think I'm not cut out to be a soldier...
I can't believe there's such a scary beast here...\nThe environment that the Eumanos are living in is\npretty harsh...
By the way...It's gonna be pretty troublesome if\nCoenubia ends up controlling this beast,\nisn't it?!
Have you been hiding here all the time?\nEveryone is leaving, let's go...
After all, I don't think I can do this...\nJust go and leave me here, please...
Hmm...
Whoa! Hey, hey, what are you doing?!\nI don't wanna go anymore, put me downnnnn!!
